messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Sanjeev Kumar <sanjeev@medtrend.health>, Elena Park <elena.park@medtrend.health>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 15:02:00 +0000
Subject: SIG initiation + clarifying questions (SOC2 / HIPAA / GDPR) — MedTrend

Hi Sanjeev / Elena,

Great speaking earlier — thanks for the demo and for sharing the high-level use cases. Quick recap and proposed next steps on the security/compliance side so we can get the vendor questionnaire moving: 

Recap from our call:
- MedTrend will evaluate Redwood to power clinical note summarization for its provider portal (PHI in scope).
- Key compliance asks: SOC 2 Type II evidence, BAA for PHI, and clarity on data residency/GDPR for EU patients.
- You mentioned an internal security questionnaire (attached) and a preference to get the BAA in place early.

Requested clarifications (so we send a clean prefill):
1) Preferred questionnaire format: SIG Lite / SIG Standard (Consensus SIG) or the CAIQ spreadsheet, or do you want Redwood to complete your custom template? We can prefill any of the above.
2) Evidence priority: please flag which artifacts you need first (SOC 2 report, encryption KMS diagram, network diagram, pen test, architecture diagram). If BAA is highest priority we can start that in parallel.
3) Data residency: will MedTrend store or process EU patient data? If yes, please identify expected volumes and region (eu-west-1 / us-east-1 etc.).
4) Technical scope: will you be sending PHI tokens in full or via a redaction/tokenization step? Any KV-cache persistence requirements?
5) Timeline: what is your target date for security signoff / procurement?

What we’ll do next:
- I’ll loop in our security ops (Monica and Ben) to map a minimal evidence matrix and confirm whether SIG or CAIQ is the fastest path.
- We’ll attach a short SOC 2 summary + architecture snapshot for initial review.
- If you want the BAA first, share the preferred legal contact and we’ll send a DocuSign.

Attachments: medtrend-security-template.xlsx (your file from the call).

Proposed next steps:
- You confirm preferred questionnaire format + priority artifacts (reply here).
- We send prefill + evidence matrix within 2 business days.
- Schedule a 30-minute security kickoff (Monica) if needed.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,
Neha Kapoor

From: Sanjeev Kumar <sanjeev@medtrend.health>

Subject: Re: SIG initiation + clarifying questions (SOC2 / HIPAA / GDPR) — MedTrend

Neha — thanks for the clear notes and for the quick turnaround. A few answers and clarifying Qs from our side: 

1) Questionnaire format: we prefer you complete our custom template (attached) if possible — it maps to the internal procurement flow. If time is tight, SIG Lite would be acceptable.
2) Evidence priority: BAA first (legal requires), then SOC 2 Type II, then architecture/network/pen test.
3) Data residency: majority of our PHI is US-based (AWS us-east-2). We do have a small EU patient cohort but data is mirrored to eu-west-1 for analytics — will need GDPR controls documented.
4) Technical scope: initially full PHI will be sent (de-identified at a later phase). KV cache persistence: we cannot have unencrypted long-term KV persistence of PHI; ephemeral caching during inference is OK if encrypted and TTL-cleared.
5) Timeline: ideally procurement signed within 6–8 weeks.

Legal contact for BAA: Elena Park (elena.park@medtrend.health). Please send DocuSign.

Attaching: medtrend-security-template.xlsx (completed by our procurement team).

Thanks,
Sanjeev Kumar
Head of Infrastructure & Security
MedTrend Health

Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 09:15:00 +0000
Subject: Fwd: SIG initiation + clarifying questions (SOC2 / HIPAA / GDPR) — MedTrend

Ben / Monica — forwarding Sanjeev’s answers (attached). Key points for ops:

- BAA is highest priority (legal contact Elena Park). Please confirm we can produce a BAA/execute via DocuSign within 3 business days.
- SOC 2 Type II needed; we should provide the report and a short summary (what we will attach below).
- Data residency: primary US (us-east-2) with EU mirror for a small cohort — need documented GDPR controls for EU processing.
- Caching constraint: no long-term unencrypted KV persistence for PHI. Redwood currently has ephemeral KV cache with encryption at rest; need to confirm TTL behavior and auditability.

Could you do a quick inventory and propose a minimal evidence matrix for MedTrend (BAA + SOC2 + 3 tech artifacts to start)? Also confirm: is SIG Standard preferable to complete or should we prefill their custom sheet (they attached it)? My read: doing both is fine but SIG prefill + attachment of a completed custom template is ideal for procurement.

Ben — can you respond with the short answers I can share back (encryption at rest/in transit, KMS provider, KV cache TTL, pen-test cadence, SOC 2 availability)? Monica — can you draft a one-page evidence matrix and estimate time to compile the artifacts (SOC2 redaction, arch diagram, network diagram)?

Thanks — looped you both so we can respond to Sanjeev tomorrow.

Neha

Subject: Re: SIG initiation + clarifying questions (SOC2 / HIPAA / GDPR) — MedTrend

Sanjeev / Elena — thanks for the quick answers. See responses below and attached artifacts for initial review.

Short answers (for procurement):
- BAA: we can execute a Redwood standard BAA via DocuSign. Neha (sales) will kick; expecting signature within 3 business days of sending. Legal contact on your side: Elena Park (per your note).
- SOC 2: Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II report (period ending 2026-06-30). We are attaching a redacted summary and can provide the full report under NDA.
- Encryption & KMS: encryption in transit (TLS 1.2+); at-rest encryption using customer-managed KMS is supported for Dedicated/Private deployments. For hosted API we use AWS KMS with envelope encryption; customer-managed keys via Bring-Your-Own-Key are available on Dedicated/Private.
- KV cache: ephemeral caching only for inference; default TTL is 2 hours for PHI contexts and caches are encrypted at rest. We can configure shorter TTLs and disable persistent KV storage for your tenant. Audit logs include cache access events in the Console.
- Pen test cadence: annual third-party pen tests; last completed 2026-05-15. Summary of findings available.
- Data residency: we can pin workloads to us-east-2; for EU mirror flows we will document GDPR controls and subprocessors.

Attachments included:
- redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (SOC 2 high-level summary, redacted)
- redwood-security-arch.png (high-level architecture diagram)

Next steps (proposed):
1) I’ll send DocuSign BAA to elena.park@medtrend.health today.
2) Monica will follow up with the minimal evidence matrix (one-pager) within 24 hrs.
3) We’ll prefill the SIG Standard and also populate your custom template; expect both artifacts in 2 business days.
4) If helpful, schedule 30-min security kickoff (Monica + Ben + your infra lead) — propose Tue 09/28 or Wed 09/29.

Please confirm the kickoff slot that works best and whether you want the full SOC 2 report under NDA vs. the redacted summary attached.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
